description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences) for two language models under three different training conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories, displaying two models, "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini", ordered from left to right without a general axis label. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)", using a linear scale that ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.25. The chart features grouped bars, with each model category containing a cluster of three side-by-side bars. According to the legend in the top left, the bar colors represent the training condition: grey represents the "Control" condition, teal represents "Before Introspection Training", and dark purple represents "After Introspection Training". For GPT-4o, the grey Control bar is approximately 0.10, the teal Before Introspection Training bar is roughly 0.54, and the dark purple After Introspection Training bar is about 0.74. For GPT-4o-mini, the grey Control bar is the shortest in the chart, dipping slightly below the zero line to approximately -0.01, while the teal Before Introspection Training bar is near 0.51, and the dark purple After Introspection Training bar is the tallest at approximately 0.75. The main categories are not sorted by height, but the groups follow a consistent experimental order from left to right. Additionally, every bar is visually emphasized with a vertical error bar indicating data variability.
